issue.title: Record the Today mark decision (decisions:today-mark-shows-ledger-today)

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Proposed by bob-cli-9r.1 note 1, 9r.2 note 1, 9r.3 note 1, 9r.4 note 1, and 9r.5 note 1. Add the immutable decision strand `decisions/today-mark-shows-ledger-today.md` (keyword "Today Marks Show The Ledger Today As A Display-Only 🍅"), shaped like the existing decisions strands. Claim: open #task lines on today's plan (a dedicated Task Link under one of today's open Pomodoros) show a display-only 🍅 right after the identity glyph, computed at read time from the bob-ledger-tools Today cache; truthful or neutral (duplicate ids, unprovable rendered rows, cache-not-ready, and daily notes stay unmarked); never written to the vault. Rejected alternatives: residence in the daily note, history (closed-Pomodoro links), a TODAY pill, a sun mask, a trailing chip, a line tint, and an opt-in body-class gate (it would hide marks in popouts; see bob-cli-9q). Cost: a second read-time consumer of the JS Today cache. Reopens when Bryan finds the mark noisy or wants the history ghost tone. Evidence: plan:202610/today_marks.md, research:202610/today_task_line_marks/today_task_line_marks.md, bob-cli docs/today-marks.md (1b158e66), bob-plugins ee9d7e6/66a9597/e4c71bc/035296a. Link [[decisions/today-is-read-from-the-ledger]]. Run sase memory init only when implementing with appropriate authorization. The epic selected memory_today_mark_record=no automatically (planner default, no human review), not by human rejection; no memory was changed during the epic or its landing.

issue.creation_reason: Every bob-cli-9r phase proposed this follow-up because the epic's auto-decision skipped the decisions-web record; Bryan should decide whether to record it.
